nom: VANICREAM Moisturizing Cream with Pump for Sensitive Skin

avis.titre: Would not recommend for sensitive skin!!!
avis.texte: This product is supposed to be good for sensitive skin, yet left me with allergic contact dermatitis. Would not get if you have sensitive skin, it makes the problem 10 times worse!!
This was the first time I purchased this moisturizer and I definitely plan to make this a staple in my routine. I really love it, it is not greasy at all and feels very hydrating

I love the smooth, creamy feel. I was dissappointed to read that petroleum (petrolatum) is one of its ingredients. Just because of this ingredient I will not recommend it to anyone who is conscious of what they are putting on their skin.

avis.titre: I will definitely be continuing to purchase this product!
avis.texte: I am 37 and have suffered severe eczema since I was 5. This is the first product in my entire life that has provided long lasting relief. ZERO itch and my skin has never felt this amazing!

please dont change this product and also keep selling the one without the pump (weird non recyclable thin plastic,bad stuff) I have tried Lubiderm, Aveeno, Gold Bond and your sunscreen and all had headache inducing mystery ingredient, (maybe very absorbent and easily contaminated by voc from soft plastic packaging or ambient air?)also the softer and more pliable the packaging the more susceptible to contamination from sitting on shelves with allt the fragranced crap sold in stores these days. PLEASE keep selling the one without the pump as it has an inside seal to keep VOC out and minimal ingredients. Some of us really need it

I live in a desert climate where moisturizer is not optional, but every other brand/product I tried was making my skin angry. I was hesitant to try this, fearing it would be greasy due to the high petrolatum content. I took a chance on it, and am glad I did! It's not greasy, absorbs very well, and makes my skin feel soft and hydrated. Great product!

Vanicream moisturizing Cream is thick and absorbs quickly into your skin. I have sensitive skin and read all the ingredients. I found Vanicream online at Ulta and use their products . No hidden fragrances. I went to the dermatologist and she recommended Vanicream for my skin and I had already bought it. Great validation.

I love this product so much. This including snail mycin + black girl sunscreen— is what keeps my skin extra glowy and super smooth and soft. It'll onyl leave a white cast if you use to much, and also make sure you rub it in well. A little goes a long way. One tub lasts me about a year, and i use it everyday. You can also use it on your body especially if you have dry skin. 10/10
Absolutely love this product! I cant believe I've waited this long to try it. Super thick, a little goes a long way. Absorbs well and leaves my skin so hydrated.

I have used the Cerave cream for eczema for years and decided to try Vanicream because I use their products on my face. This is the best EVER! Cleared my dry skin patches with consistent use. It is very thick, but does soak in.
Everything burns my face, even products for sensitive skin. This is so thick and such a good value for the money, and my face was soothed and not burned! So in love with this

I LOVE this huge tub of moisturizing cream from Vanicream! Im on my 2nd purchase since before Christmas. It lasts a very long time, the lotion/cream is *very* hydrating and it sinks into my skin quickly. My skin is not left sticky, my hands feel 100% moisturized after using! It is also unscented, which I appreciate. I love that it comes with a pump, making it super easy to access. I highly recommend, considering you get so much for a great price!

I have been looking for a product to keep me moisturized in the winter and this product did give me hope. The texture of the lotion is sunscreen like, very rich, and the smell is almost medicinal like. The lotion does provide my body with a quick source of renewal but its effects are short term for both hands and body. I wanted to like it so bad but I think the winter air makes it hard for me to find lasting products. I will by this again when the air is less dry to test its affects.

I purchased this to use as night time moisturizer during the winter since my skin gets so dry, and it unexpectedly improved my eczema! It has also really helped heal a burn scar on my wrist. I apply it over my arms, legs, and feet before bedtime, let is absorb for about 5 mins, and wake up to soft skin.

My skin is very oily and sensitive and I decided to try this out because I like getting my moneys worth but also being on budget. This cream is awesome the bottle is big and it leaves my skin hydrated all day! Love it never ordered a moisturizer 2x but this one takes the cake !

avis.titre: Ulta why is this so expensive here
avis.texte: I love this cream! Do not get me wrong with this review headline, BUT Ulta over charges! You can almost buy 2 of these at other retailers compared to the price here at Ulta. Ulta do better!

I, at almost 52 years old, have managed to get eczema. Never having it before in my life, I was NOT aware of the extreme ITCH it causes! The itch is unbearable! I got a prescription cream which miraculously helped, and the doctor told me to get a really good lotion for my dry skin. Which led me to this. Vanicream is a thick and rich lotion that makes your skin feel amazing. It really helps irritation and eczema flare ups along the way. I will be a repeat customer!

This is a pretty great moisturizer for your feet! My feet get super dry and cracked when I stop using this, but when I'm using it actively and consistently I have no issues with that whatsoever. It is super thick, making it extra moisturizing so if you don't like a thick moisturizer, this one's not for you! 10/10 in my book though!
I went through an entire tub and bought more after. I love this for my whole body. It is pretty thick, so a little goes a long, way especially for the face.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: Finally a moisturizing cream that lasts longer than 24 hrs. My skin loves this product.

I wanted to love this moisturizer, I really did. I have really dry skin around my eye area (like red, itchy, raised/inflames, peeling skin around the eyes in the winter), normal on the lower half of my face, and oily on the forehead. So im definitely a combination skin type, and i had heard great things about vanicream, and my sister uses it, so when i first got into skincare, I thought it would be a good option. This moisturizer is SO THICK. Unbelievably thick. And hard to spread. I do an oil cleanse routine, as i have a lot of sebaceous filaments and clogged pores but not too much acne issues. I would oil cleanse, and use my toner. At this point in my routine, i would feel like my pores were so clear and my face was so shiny. Then, i would apply my vanicream, and it was like my 10 minutes of previous skincare didn't exist. It's like i was watching the moisturizer clog my pores back up. It also feels like this moisturizer never soaks in. Any contact my face has with any object just seems to get slimy again from the moisturizer, which is a big issue seeing as i wear glasses constantly and a cpap at night. So im constantly pushing my glasses back up and cleaning off the bridge, and my cpap just leaks in the middle of the night with mask farts because the silicone is slicked with moisturizer, even if i applied it 3 yours before bedtime. I will say, i havent had issues with dry skin around my eyes since i started using it. So if you dont care to minimize pores or get rid of your

Everyone raves about how wonderful this stuff is so i thought I'd give it a try. It leaves your skin feeling horribly sticky! I've used it twice, thinking maybe i used too much this first time. Nope, still sticky and gross. So disappointed!
i use this as my moisturizer at night and it helps my dry skin so much! it lasts forever too.

I have used this product for 25 years and have talked to hundreds of people about it. Being in AZ in the winter, with the dry climate-vanicream cream is the absolute best to use.😊😊 Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

My son has had eczema from birth. He's now in his 20s and your cream has always helped him with daily skin care and your ointment is his go to for flares (so please finish the reformulation and get that back on the market!). I actually use and love your deodorant! Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

We live in a dry climate, and cannot live without multiple tubs of vanicream in our home. Hands, feet, face! Everywhere! Works great on sensitive skin and those that have eczema. Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.
I love this product as well as the body ointment ! Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

I started using the vanicream brand due to starting accutane. This moisturizer feels and looks like it's hydrating my very dry skin. I recommend all vanicream products to anyone I know. :) Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

I have spent my entire life with terrible eczema flare ups that I was consistently prescribed steroids for. No lotion ever worked and most I was allergic to. Eventually a dermatologist suggested Vanicream and my skin has been almost perfect ever since. This was 8 years ago and still going strong as the best lotion I've ever used. Thank you!!! Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

My fiancé and I both have sensitive skin (he is a type 1 diabetic) and we both get very dry, especially in the winter months. Vanicream Moisturizing Cream is the only lotion that has worked for our body. It is thick, moisturizing and has zero scent. We love this stuff! Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

I have Ehlers Danlos and live with multiple severe allergies. This is the first moisturizing cream I've found that works and doesn't cause a reaction. For the first time in 30 years my skin is clear and healthy. I keep this next to my bathroom sink & on my bedside table and use it daily. I also appreciate that it is truly scent free which is a game changer for those of us who react to scents. Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.
I layer this on top of ny retinol at night wnd it keeps my face well moisturized

Let me just say I was excited to use this product until I actually used it! I have very sensitive skin and after seeing so many positive reviews/ recs from friends I decided to try it… This is the only thing I have changed in my routine and when I say my acne hasn't been this bad in a long time I mean it. It is SO so bad. Everywhere (face,neck,chest, upper arms) I used it is breaking out. Definitely returning this product!

I have struggled with severe perioral dermatitis for the past 2 years. I've tried just about every face wash, moisturizer, antibiotic creams, you name it. Nothing has ever been able to clear it up like this cream has!!!! I use it after cleansing my face with the Vanicream cleanser and my skin is LOVING IT. No more dermatitis, redness, flaking, itching!!! THANK YOU VANICREAM ❤️
this is the only moisturizer I can use on my sensitive dry skin. I've used it for years along with their gentle face wash.

avis.titre: Finally a moisturizer for my sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I have extremely sensitive skin and live in a dry climate. I have tried multiple moisturizers ranging anywhere from more natural, low-ingredient to high-end, dermatologist grade. Everything either made me breakout, left my skin red and still dry, and in some cases even caused chemical burns. I've tried brands like CeraVe, Ethique, Clinique, Dermalogica, etc. and none seem to help. After doing some research, I saw others say this low-ingredient, fragrance-free moisturizer helped them. After only a few uses, I was AMAZED!! My skin stayed hydrated all day, was noticeably less red, and wasn't breaking out. I would say maybe start with the lotion if you're on the oily side or live in a more humid climate. But as someone with already dry, sensitive skin and living in a dry climate, this has worked WONDERS. Cannot recommend enough. I hope the formula never changes!
I use the moisturizing cream and love it. It leaves a healthy glow on my skin. I have dry skin and regular lotion seems to leave my skin dull so I tried this.

This was a highly recommended product on tiktok so of course i had to try it out. Its a good price for the amount you get, but not a good moisturizer in my opinion. The product did not absorb at all, sat on top of my skin all night, quite sticky, and made it impossible to get comfortable since my hair would get stuck to my face if i moved. Product also had an unpleasant smell.
I love that it's moisturizing, but having super sensitive skin like I do, I was expecting it to not make my face break out in a rash.

After many recommendations for hydrating skin especially the face where I have combination to oily skin; I decided to give this a try. For me personally, it is very heavy and greasy. I did like the results of my face in the morning. That is why I am giving it 2 stars. It looked more plump and supple, but still had a pretty greasy feeling to it. I even used it on my arms and legs and felt very greasy and hard to rub in. It literally felt like slathering thick Crisco on my face and I cannot stand my face to feel even greasier or thick suffocating layers of product. I am really bummed because I so bad wanted to like this, but I cannot deal with how heavy and greasy it is. My hair was sticking to my face all night. And maybe this was not a good product for combo to oily skin types, but it says for all skin types. If you like the thick greasy feeling that lasts consistently 8+ hours than this is the product for you. To me, Aquaphor or Vaseline ointment would have been more suitable because they are nowhere near as greasy or thick and being ointment based we all know they are very greasy, but not as greasy as Vanicream Moisturizing Crème. The mild results that I received from it and liked when waking up are not worth the annoyance of the texture and greasiness of this product.
This product is awesome and helped soothe my daughters eczema on her hand

avis.titre: Not for "any" skin type, only sensitive?
avis.texte: I purchased this becauae of a tiktok I saw. I thought it would be okay to use on my face even though I have "normal" skin because this is a product for "sensitive" skin, meaning it would be okay for any skin type (so I thought). I broke out after 2 days of using it. I don't normally breakout, so when a whole patch of zits popped up on both my cheeks and forehead, I was so confused. I stopped using it after another day because I knew nothing else I was using caused this since everything I normally use hasn't caused this reaction. After about 3 or 4 days, everything cleared up and I am now going to return this. Lesson I took away from this, don't buy everything you see someone asvertising on tiktok!

avis.titre: DO NOT USE ON YOUR FACE
avis.texte: I was influenced from tiktok and was so excited to not spend so much money on skincare, but this left me with the worst acne I've ever had in my life. I recently saw something that said it clogs pores and I can't use it on my face anymore.

Got this product after seeing it listed as a good option for people with sensitive skin who are acne prone a few times online, plus I needed a thicker, unscented moisturizer for my night routine. Ordered it and prayed this stuff wasn't going to instantly upset my skin (products that don't agree with me tend to give me breakouts and irritate/burn my skin). Good news for me - I didn't seem to have any of those feared reactions. While this product is definitely on the thicker side, you don't need very much of it and you get a decent amount of product for the price. I still haven't finished my first bottle, but I'm happy to report that in the last 2 months of using it daily, my skin feels more hydrated, doesn't seem to be causing me any extra breakouts, and I wake up with soft, nourished skin (or at least, that's what it feels like). If you're a sensitive skin girl or guy, this one might be worth a try.

This is the only moisturizer I will use for my face. I have always suffered from severely dry skin and this stuff has made my skin feel and look amazing! I love applying this at nighttime after all of my other skincare products. You do have to be careful with the amount you use, because this stuff is thick!! Being as you only have to use a little of the product, the amount you get in this container is more than enough to last you at least a year (if only using on your face). I would however only recommend this at night and not under makeup. I feel like it is too heavy of a moisturizer to sit well under makeup.

This product is advertised as clean but the 2nd ingredient is petrolatum!! That is infuriating when people who care and/or have health issues & concerns. I've had people argue with me in the past that there's "nothing wrong with petrolatum" and even "it's healthy"! To those people I encourage you to look it up & let that sink in!.Seriously, I'm not asking you to - gasp - read a book, but Google this nasty stuff! ok

Can be used on broken and very irritated skin! Very fatt, but still lightweight. The only problem packing. Like one fifth part is really hard to get from. Impossible with pump, so you need to open all the big thing every time... and that left part is enough for using like a couple of months... So I would say: cream itself - 15 out of 10, packing - 4 out of 10.

avis.titre: Wonderful rich but gentle moisturizing cream
avis.texte: I was hesitant to use this on my face as it has a really thick consistentcy but I decided to give it a try. I have acne prone skin and this moisturizer did not break me out at all. I now use it every night as part of my skin care routine. It does a great job of moisturizing especially in the dry winter months.

Tried everything am 64 started getting adult acne this not only helped clear it up but the lotion kept my skin from drying but not to heavy. A great find for anyone that wants a safe, reliable product that is reasonably priced and really works
holy grail tbh. vanicream in general is a holy grail and its so underrated. this is way better than all high end moisturizers i have.
This smooths the skin very well. Works better than any pore filling primer I've ever tried. Looks phenomenal under makeup.

avis.titre: Fantastic for dry skin & keratosis pilaris
avis.texte: This is one of the best lotions I've ever used. I've been using it on my face at night and on my arms during the day, and it's made such a huge difference.

Ive used face oils, serums, different types of moisturizers even night ones and this one is the only one (off second use!) that has saved my skin from dry flakes!!!!!!! Im so hapoy it comes for the big amount for a reasonable price. Thank you vanicream❤️

Let me preface this by saying, I am the daughter of a Dermatologist, a physician myself and we live in the tropics. I have eczema, worsened in the heat, which is year round. I first thought this was going to be way too thick and would cause me to feel gross and sticky when sweating but instead it rubs in well, feels great on my skin and is not greasy. It is moisturizing without feeling greasy and I love it.

I suffered from clogged pores, perioral dermititis for several months. I tried tons of different products and nothing worked. This is the ONLY cream that worked. Not even the Vanicream moisturizer with a green label worked for me. This line is the only line that keeps my skin smooth and acne-free. Please keep making this product!!!

This cream may be too thick for those with only skin types. However after 2 weeks of use this moisturizer has helped significantly with my eczema -rosecea- acne prone skin. I cannot use most moisturizers, drugstore or otherwise, since the majority of them are formulated with niacinimide, hyaluronic acid, squalene, fragrance, and many other potentially irritating ingredients. I've been using this on my dry patches and it helps to heal my acne scabs post break out. Would recommend to those with sensitive flaky skin.

Suffer from Winter Acne. Was never big on applying any kind of moisturizer on my face due to my battle with acne. Always thought a moisturizer was the devil for dry/ acne faces, LOL! My skin is so severely dry to the point where my face is cracking and flaking. Did some research a came upon Vanicream. Really like that it was fragrance free and didn't have all that other garbage. So I decided to roll the dice and so happy that I did. I'm seeing a complete turn around in just 1 week. At first I was just going to use it nightly but decided to use morning's as well. Vanicream has made me a believer when it comes to moisturizing. Definitely helping me through the drop in temperature outside and the dry air inside. Plus I haven't broken out at all. So if you are in my shoes as well get in your car and go get this stuff. Thank You Vanicream!

avis.titre: Best moisturizer for kids with eczema
avis.texte: We have used Vanicream for the last 7years on my kiddo who has moderate eczema. She moisturizes head-to-toe with it daily in the morning and after showering at night. It has been a lifesaver for her. It keeps her skin moisturized and calm compared to all the other creams and lotions we have tried.

My dermatologist recommended this in substitute of the very expensive La Mer moisturizing cream I had been using. Vanicream is 200 times less expensive (that is a true calculation) and works better! It goes on smoothly and nourishes my dry, sensitive skin without any irritation or redness. I am so glad I found this cream.

avis.titre: The only moisturizer I will ever use.
avis.texte: As someone that suffers with acne, a sensitive skin barrier, and very reactive skin- this is the ONLY moisturizer I have used the past decade and will continue to use. I use this vanicream moisturizing cream and the vanicream lite lotion (same ingredients, different consistencies) depending on my skins needs. This works wonderfully with the very few antioxidants, actives and sunscreen I use and the consistency is very smooth, hydrating and luxurious and causes zero reaction/stinging. I've tried many 'sensitive skin' moisturizers, including the famous Cerave Moisturizing Cream, and DRMTLGY Peptide Night Cream and all of them made my skin congested, irritated, itchy, red, form comedones, etc. I will never stray from these gentle moisturizers, Thank you Vanicream!

I had a rosacea flair up and was inflamed and red. I was in a lot of pain. Along with seeing my dr, I began using this cream on my face. Immediately it felt comforting and it seriously tones down the redness. I use it with my tretinoin and it is wonderful for combatting the side effects. I have read review some individuals don't like the feel of this cream on their face. I love it! I have the lotion too and will use it more in the summer months. Also I'm glad this cream does not have niacinamide as it stings my cheeks. Thank you Vanicream and thank you for the big tub. Great for the whole body.

avis.titre: Amazing for dry skin and eczema!
avis.texte: I have a lot of eczema and dry flakey skin on my hands and wrists and this has been the only moisturizer to truly calm my skin down. I finally found a lotion that actually penetrates all of my dry, scaly skin! My hands no longer feel like an alligators. I lather it all over my body too right when I get out of the shower while my skin is still damp and it makes my skin so soft. I don't use it as my face moisturizer though because I'm not a fan of the sticky residue-like feeling after application, which is why I'm giving it four stars. That tacky after feeling is a little annoying, but overall I highly recommend if you have extremely dry and eczema prone skin!

This product is a life saver!!!! I use this on myself and my 2 kids aged 2&5. We all have extremely sensitive eczema prone skin that is easily irritated. This is the ONLY product that we have used that does not cause any sort of reaction or irritation .I've spent thousands trying to find a product that works for us and finally found this and will NEVER use anything else. We use it face-to-toe. It doesn't cause any oiliness or acne on the face and is extremely moisturizing without any sticky or gross feeling left behind (I have sensory issues and am very weird about the feeling of lotions/ moisturizers but this feels like I'm not wearing anything after it soaks in) Please don't ever discontinue this product! I would 110% recommend to anyone

My skin is very sensitive and acne prone. I'm using tretinoin and My skin gets incredibly dry, flakey with rashes in the winter and this is the only thing that works and doesn't make me break out. It's amazing I wake up and my dry flakey skin is no more. Thank you!

This feels rich and creamy on my 75 year old skin and lasts. It has the hyaluronic acid and peptides of more expensive brands, without any drying fragrance. At my age there are no miracles but this is my favorite - and I've tried Clinique, Estee, Roc, Olay, Neutrogena and Loreal over the years.

I have dry to normal skin on my body and my face is oily to dry. This Moisturizing cream is amazing ??? on my whole body and face . It moisturizes completely without ANY oily residue. Lots of brands state they're fragrance free, this cream actually is. I'm excited to try more products from this line.

My child was born with eczema and later we learned the food allergies. We tried every brand the pediatric suggested (Eucerin, Cetaphil, Aveeno products for eczema and other brands that I researched). I came to learn about Vanicream through grandparents who had a grandchild with eczema and using Vanicream. No medical doctor (including dermatologist) ever mentioned Vanicream. The instant we used this cream on my baby, it worked wonderfully. It controlled the eczema. We no longer needed to apply a moisturizer and layer with Aquaphor (petroleum jelly base). It was a life saver for our family and including myself. We are now a big fan of Vanicream and using the moisturizer for the whole family everyday ever since. Please do not change the ingredients and I cannot thank you enough. Looking forward to more of your products. Would be nice if Vanicream expands into the cosmetic line with more friendly chemicals, if that is even possible!!

I have learned to only use vanicream products. My psoriasis and many skin issues are better using all of the products. My favorites are the cream for my whole body (especially hands) and hair conditioner. I can't use shampoos as they are too harsh and strip the natural oils. For years I have been using the conditioner as a co-wash and it works great! It cleans and rinses out without leaving my fine hair limp. If only they could add zinc (like they do the shampoo I can't use). Bigger bottles (because when you co-wash you use more) used for co-wash seems to me to be the healthiest thing for super sensitive scalps. Please start making it!

With age my skin became very dry and sensitive.What I love about this cream is that it is thick and really moisturizes and creates a barrier of protection, specially after l long warm shower.Skin feels comfortable, soft and young again.Thanks Vanicream for another wonderful product!

avis.titre: Vanicream  Moisturizing Cream Net Wt. 1 lb
avis.texte: Very good product. Just so you know, the pump in your new container sucks.

Having worked in dermatology for nearly 6 years, I know the struggle many people have with sensitive skin and inflammatory conditions like eczema and psoriasis. I am so pleased with this product and ALL Vanicream products as they are far superior in quality amongst their competitors. My 9 mo old son was suffering from eczema and Vanicream lotions and moisturizers have been the only options that help reduce, if not, completely clear his eczema flares. I trust this brand implicitly and am so thankful they continue to make high quality products that work! Thank you Vanicream!

I have super sensitive skin and every single moisturizer I tried set my face on fire. This is the first moisturizer that I have tried that did NOT do that. I'm eternally grateful for dermatologist Dr. Dray on YouTube for highly recommending this cream.

I have rosacea and struggled with finding a gentle moisturizer that won't aggravate my rosacea. Most Cerave's products didn't work for me. My dermatologist recommended this cream and It's has been live saver! My rosacea was managed by using this and my prescribed Azelaic acid. The only complaint I'd have is this product while being pretty thick, is not hydrating enough. My skin kept getting dehydrated during the day.

I use this products in my skincare routine every day AM and PM. I absolutely love this product. My face is very oily but this product makes my skin not oily or dry and leaves my skin soft. I'm looking foward to try other products from Vanicream

College student here!PLEASE DON'T STOP MAKING THESE!I have tried everything under the sun to calm my acne. Cetaphil dried me out while Ceraves reformulated cleansers and moisturizers break me out BADI stumbled upon a few YouTube videos talking about vanicream being perfect for people with really bad acne and skin issues so I gave it a shot and instantly after 2 days of using the Gentle Cleanser and moisturizing cream my acne has gone down SO MUCH like dude I'm so shocked I haven't tried these sooner.This is now my forever go to brand!To people looking for an alternative to Cetaphil and Cerave stop right here!
I have super dry, flakey, sensitive skin and the vanicream moisturizer is the only thing I've found to help.

This is the best cream for sensitive skin. I have tried so many 'sensitive skin' products and lotions but they still burn my face and I'd have to wash it off. This is the ONLY cream/lotion that truly does not burn my face, not even a tingle. This is my favorite cream to wear because I love the thickness because it moisturizes and doesn't look thick when on. Anyone who has a sensitive face should get this product ASAP!!
Vanicream is the only product that has brought relief to the eczema on my face! I saw instant results! It worked within a few hours after I applied it to my skin! Thank you Vanicream!
Its a thick moisturizing lotion that completely absorbs. I have sensitive skin and it is the most gentle lotion that I ever used. I have bought 3 bottles so far in the last year.

Recommended by dermatologist for body skin breakout due to allergy. It's changed my skin and itching associated with it. My husband is 84 and since he started using it has skin of fifty year old. I always recommend it to friends and family and feedback always is 'we are hooked.' I'm also using soap and just found out about hair products which will order.
I love this moisturizer. I use it everyday. It is super hydrating and gentle!

Long time back my son was seeing a dr. for acne. They had Vanicream samples on the counter. I took one. It works great on under eye wrinkles and bags! Wish I had taken a handful. Just today, I found the empty tube (which I saved) and saw there is a website on it. I just ordered the pound jar with pump.

avis.titre: Recommended to me by my doctor to fix bleeding cracking skin
avis.texte: My toes and fingers would get so dry they crack, peel, flake off, and start bleeding. I tried so many other basic lotions to try to hydrate my skin so it could heal and stop cracking but they just didn't do anything and would just wear off so fast and not go into my skin. But this lotion doesn't feel oily, does feel damp, but it fixed my problem and my skins back to normal. I don't want to use any other lotion.

I have Diabetic, Eczema, Follicuiitis,Roseca, you name it my face was always being triggered by something, this is the only product that does what it says.I no longer have the pustules from Folicuilitis and Roseca, The Diabetic skin is just always dry what ever moisturizer I used always made my face break out adding acne to the mix. Add just summer time sweating and this face and my skin is all good !!

avis.titre: The best skin cream ever made!!
avis.texte: I have oily skin and have never used lotion because I thought Aveeno and Eucerin were too oily, greasy, and didn't feel good. THIS, feels good. Rich, buttery, but not greasy or sticky.
I have very sensitive skin and this cream really absorbs in the skin without a greasy feel. A little goes a LONG way so it lasts a long time. It is my favorite moisturizer I have ever used.

A nice thick moisturizing cream that does not irritate at all. The big tub is very economical. I use it on my face (at night) and body. I use acne medications on my face at night and this moisturizer really helps to prevent dryness and flakiness from those medications.

My skin has become very sensitive so after reading reviews I decided to try this cream. I love it. It moisturizes skin without looking greasy and helps with redness as well as the odd pimple. I also use the gentle face cleanser and love that too. No fragrance and simple ingredients. Many anti aging products end up irritating my skin and make me look older rather than what they claim to do. Would love to see a toner in this line sometime. Wish more stores carried the entire line. Will definitely keep using as it has really improved my skin.

I have a bit of advice for those who think the cream is too sticky. When first dispensed you think 'ick'. But warm it in your fingertips for a bit and PRESS into your skin.A much better result will be realized. It's a much better cream than the expensive ones on the market. After it soaks in, make up goes on smoothly. The moisturizing benefits last until you wash it off. And it's available without a lot of ordering and waiting!! Great cream and other products.
This cream really works. It was recommended by my podiatrist.

avis.titre: Just because it rains in Seattle
avis.texte: You may still have dry skin. Until a cousin gave me a tube of moisturing skin cream 15 years ago I had never found a product in my 60 plus years which did the trick. I doubt there is a better one in the world! Thanks. Finally writing a review.?

I needed to find something that would cure my severely cracked heels. I've been applying the cream twice a day with a layer of Vaniply over it at night, and problem solved. This product actually seems to heal the skin. It also works great as a facial moisturizer. A thin layer of Vaniply over the cream makes an excellent make-up base. Foundation just glides on, stays all day, and looks amazing. I am just loving these high performing products.

avis.titre: It's ok but not for me
avis.texte: It is greasy and thick and ud have this residue on your skin afterwards. I didn't enjoy it but I guess people are out there who enjoy this kinda formula. I saw very good reviews but it's not for me. Maybe if ur tastes and skin are similar to mine, you'd fell the same way.
Works excellent on my hands and feet. I've been trying a lot of lotions and medicated cream but only Vanicream works. I am using this cream for about 8 months already.

Got some free samples from my dermatologist and then purchased the cream in the pump bottle. The product has been great and has taken care of my itchy face. Will never be without this cream, works great all over.

Juan Ponce de León wishes he had found this cream! Because of my dermatologists recommendation, I have been using Vanicream for over 20 years now. I use this cream twice a day, and I look younger than many women my age. This is the BEST product for healthy, soft skin!
I got this product last week and it feels greasy and it does not smell good at all. I checked if it was expired but it was not

was recommended by my allergist because my skin itched all over due to all of the chemicals that were in my soap and lotion. I love all of the products. I saw a picture of your staff on the website, you need to hire a more diverse staff.

Due to my psoriasis outbreak, I have to be extra cautious using lotions. I began using Vanicream about 3 years ago and I absolutely love it. It has no perfumes or other skin drying agents in it. It glides smoothly and evenly on my skin. I highly recommend it for anyone who has dry skin. My skin stays soft and moist.
i've tried multiple lotions and most actually make my skin worse. Vanicream is amazing!!!! it softens and leaves my hands looking great!

I spent months with rash, pimples, and dry itching alligator skin. Allergy tests showed me allergic to most trees, grasses and weeds so my allergist got me off all my organic products, treated the irritation, and put me on Vanicream. It is thick and takes a bit to rub it in but oh so worth it! My skin is softer, rarely itchy, and rashes are gone. This product has been a lifesaver. I now use multiple vanicream and free & clear products and am pleased with all of them.

I've used this product for the last couple of years. In fact, I use multiple items – Vanicream skin cream, Vanicream Free and Clear Shampoo and I my skin issues have subsided. I tried other similar products and this brand is the only thing that keeps my seborrheic dermatitis under control. I love that I can order it directly online for a bit less, but when I need it ASAP it's available at the drugstore. If you're wondering if you should take a chance on any of these products, DO IT...you won't regret it.

This cream is much better than Cetaphil's moisturizers and any other drugstore brand. It is for people who have sensitive skin and are prone to rashes, acne, etc. I tried it on my body for a month and it stops itching. It also gets rid of psoriasis with continued use. It is also great for diaper rash. As for the face it's wonderful. It will not cause breakouts (it actually gets rid of breakouts and prevents them). This product is also at the correct ph and very effective for dry skin. It's not greasy and will prevent heat rash and other issues. Try it for a month and you'll be pleasantly surprised!
I love this moisturizer because it is not greasy or Heavy on my skin.
Very good cream for eczema,just love this product so much,best ingredients!

I've had severe eczema for years. I've tried to treat it with Castile soap and natural oils but nothing helped. I began using petroleum jelly on my chapped lips and it helped more than any natural concoction I've used in the past. I found Vanicream through research online and ordered the cream, lotion, bar soap, face wash, bath oil and sunscreen. I've been using all products for about 1 week and am amazed by the difference in the way my skin looks and feels. I love everything. The cream doesn't feel heavy or sticky. It absorbs into my skin and it is really helping to repair my skin from the years of using a high ph soap with inadequate moisturizer. The sunscreen doesn't get superb reviews online but I love it. There is almost no scent and I didn't have to rub very much to eliminate any white cast. I highly recommend all of the products I purchased.
It has been a week since i have been introduced to this product by my dermatologist. My skin feels moisturized, no itching whatsoever. Will definitely continue using this. ?
this creme healed me through a terrible flare of rosaceait is excellent!i pat it all over my face gently and it feels soothed and protected!!!!!!

I struggle with Chronic Urticaria, impacted by many common chemicals and ingredients in so many products. When this started over 2 years ago, I began looking for relief. This cream is rich, and absorbs completely, leaving skin feeling hydrated, fresh and soft. I am using vani cream exclusively, and they have replaced products for everyone in my household. Recently, patch testing identified severe chemical reactions, and surprises for me as I began to identify products that needed to be eliminated. Vanicream products contain none of them!!!! Thank You.

I have rosacea and just diagnosed with 7 different allergies, fragrance Mix, fragrance Mix II, Ylang Ylang Oil, etc..... It was very hard for me to find something that would not make my face worse, burn, sting when applied, and then I found the Vanicream Moisturizing Skin Cream. It took about 2-3 days to see an improvement, so stick with this product. I also purchased the Vanicream HC. 1% Hydrocortisone Cream, this helped relieve my itching due to flare-ups.Will continue to buy all Vanicream Produts.

I am an 89 year old male and over the years I tried many different skin creams for my dry feet before a foot doctor recommended Vanicream. I expected some relief, but I was totally surprised that this fast absorbing product has absolutely stopped the flaking and other symptoms of dry feet which had plagued me for many years–and my father before me!. I use it daily after my shower on my arms hands, ankles and feet. I recommend it very highly!

A friend gave me a sample of Vanicream to try and I love it. I never realized how sensitive my skin was until I used this product and seen a difference in my facial skin. I haven't used any firming cream that makes my skin feel more firmer than Vanicream. I hope you will come out with a product that has anti-agers in it. I would definitely use it.

I really like this cream and all the Free & Clear products (although the Shampoo is too drying for my hair type). I have allergies to preservatives and these are not found in the Vanicream or Free & Clear products. Thank you.

we have tried every cream for my daughter's eczema, and nothing worked. we saw a dermatologist and she recommended this & it has been great. it's not a miracle cream, she still does get flares but they aren't as pronounced as they used to be & when she does have a flare, this does not burn like Aveeno did. (Aveeno makes a great product but it did burn my daughter's skin!) If you have kids with eczema, i would absolutely recommend to try this out. I have the lite lotion and don't like it as much as the regular old cream. I want to try the Vaniply ointment too.

I received this as a gift from a friend and I absolutely love this cream, it's thick and so creamy and feel so good on the skin, not greasy but leave your skin moist and smooth and it last all day. Thanks so much.
This was recommended by my doctor. I love, love, love this cream. I use it everyday on: Face, hands, arms, legs and feet. Keeps my skin soft.

My husband,a diabetic, was given this product for his dry cracked feet. A month after use, his feet were so pretty. ,I started using the remaining cream after he past. It's gone now and no lotion or cream work as well.Glad I found this web site.

I love this product!! Excellent all body moisturizer! The VANICREAM Lite Lotion is perfect for my face and blended with my liquid foundation it makes my face happy, smooth and itch free! Recommended by my Dermatologist 3 years ago and have used nothing else since then!
